title: Default target mix
detail: 80 / 10 / 10 / 0 (stocks / crypto / cash / custom) until a mix is saved. Trim and add stay hints — no trades.

title: Leftover goes to book cash
detail: Ready to Assign leftover can be added as cash on the primary book. Budget math does not change.

title: Util bands
detail: Caution at 50% of cushion, high at 70%. Cushion is typed equity or book cash. Missing figures stay blank.
